verses.text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
The earth was formless and empty, and darkness covered the deep waters. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
Then God said: Let there be light. And there was light.
God saw that the light was good. God separated the light from the darkness.
God named the light day, and God named the darkness night. There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the first day.
God said: There must be sky between the waters. The sky will separate the water above from the water below.
God made the sky. God separated the water above the sky from the water below it.
God named that sky Heaven. There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the second day.
Then God said: Let the water under the sky be gathered together. Let the dry land appear. And it happened.
God named the dry land Earth. God named the water Seas. God saw that it was good.

Then God said: Let the earth grow grass. Let it grow plants that make grain, and fruit trees. The fruit trees will make fruit with seeds in it. And each plant will make its own kind of seed. Let these plants grow on the earth. And it happened.
The earth grew grass and plants that made grain. And it grew trees that made fruit with seeds in it. Every plant made its own kind of seeds. And God saw that this was good.
There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the third day.

God said: There must be lights in the sky. The lights will show when it is day and when it is night. The lights will also show the seasons and the special times. The lights will show when days and years begin and end.
Let the lights in the sky shine and give light to the earth. And it happened.
God made two big lights. God made the bigger light, the sun, to rule the day. God made the smaller light, the moon, to rule the night. God also made the stars.
God put the sun, moon, and stars in the sky. They gave light on the earth.
The sun, moon, and stars ruled over the day and over the night. They separated the light from the darkness. And God saw that this was good.
There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the fourth day.
Then God said: Let the water be filled with many living things. Let birds fly across the sky.
God created the huge sea animals. God also created all the living things in the sea. God created every kind of bird that flies in the air. God saw that it was good.
God blessed the fish and birds. God said: There must be more and more fish and water animals. The water must be full of fish. And there must be many birds on earth.
There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the fifth day.

God said: Let the land bring out all kinds of living animals. Let each animal have young of its own kind. There will be farm animals, animals that crawl on the ground, and wild animals. And it happened.
God made the wild animals and the farm animals. God made the animals that crawl on the ground. Each kind had young of its own kind. God saw that it was good.

Then God said: Now let Us make people who will be like Us. The people will rule over the fish in the sea. They will rule over the birds in the air. They will rule over the large animals. They will rule over all the little things that crawl on the earth.
So God created humans in His own image. God created humans, male and female.

God blessed the humans. God said: You must have many children and fill the earth with people. You must take charge of the earth. You must rule over the fish in the sea. You must rule over the birds in the sky. You must rule over all the animals on the earth.
God said: I am giving you every plant on the earth that makes seeds. I am giving you every tree that makes fruit with seeds in it. This will be your food.

I am also giving the green plants to every animal on earth. I am giving the green plants to every bird in the air. I am giving the green plants to every little thing that crawls on the earth. The green plants will be their food. And it happened.
God saw everything He had made, and it was very good. There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the sixth day.

verses.text: So the heavens and the earth were finished, with everything in them.
On the seventh day, God finished His work. Then God rested from all the work He had done.
God blessed the seventh day. God set that day apart as holy. On that day, God rested from all the work of creating the world.
This is the story about the creation of the heavens and the earth. This is what happened when the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.
There were no bushes or plants growing in the fields yet. The LORD God had not caused rain to fall on the earth. And there was no one to work the ground.
So a mist rose up from the earth and watered the whole ground.
Then the LORD God formed a man from the dust of the ground. He breathed the breath of life into the man's nostrils. The man became a living person.
Then the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east. He put the man He had formed in that garden.

The LORD God planted many kinds of trees in the ground. The trees were beautiful to look at, and their fruit was good to eat. In the middle of the garden, the LORD God planted the tree of life. He also planted the tree that gives knowledge of good and evil.
A river flowed from Eden and watered the garden. The river then separated and became four rivers.
The name of the first river was Pison. This river flowed around the entire land of Havilah, where there was gold.
There was good gold in that land, and sweet-smelling gum and onyx stones.
The name of the second river was Gihon. This river flowed around the whole land of Ethiopia.
The name of the third river was Hiddekel. This river flowed east of Assyria. The fourth river was the Euphrates.
The LORD God put the man in the Garden of Eden to work the soil and take care of the garden.
The LORD God said to the man: You may eat fruit from any tree in the garden.
But you must not eat from the tree that gives knowledge of good and evil. If you eat fruit from that tree, on that day you will certainly die.
Then the LORD God said: I see that it is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper who is right for him.
Then the LORD God formed all the animals and the birds out of the ground. He brought them to Adam to see what Adam would name them. Whatever Adam called each living creature became its name.
Adam gave names to all the farm animals, to all the birds in the air, and to all the wild animals. But Adam did not find a helper who was right for Adam.
So the LORD God caused Adam to fall into a deep sleep. While Adam was asleep, the LORD God took one of Adam's ribs. He closed up the flesh where the rib had been.
The LORD God used the rib from the man to build a woman. The LORD God brought the woman to the man.
Then Adam said: Here is a person like me at last. She has bones from my bones and flesh from my flesh. She was taken out of man, so she will be called woman.
That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife. In this way the two become one body.
The man and his wife were naked, but they were not ashamed.

verses.text: The snake was more crafty than any other wild animal the LORD God had made. The snake said to the woman: Did God really say you must not eat from any tree in the garden?
The woman told the snake: We can eat fruit from the trees in the garden.
But God said we may not eat fruit from the tree in the middle of the garden. God said we must not even touch it, or we will die.
But the snake said to the woman: You will not die.
God knows what will happen on the day you eat that fruit. Your eyes will be opened. You will be like God, knowing good and evil.

Then the woman saw that the tree was beautiful. Its fruit looked good to eat. She wanted it because it would make her wise. The woman took some of the fruit and ate it. She gave some to her husband, who was with her. Her husband ate it too.
Then the eyes of the man and the woman were opened. They knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together and made clothes for themselves.
During the cool part of the day, the LORD God was walking in the garden. The man and the woman heard the LORD God. They hid among the trees in the garden.
The LORD God called Adam and said: Where are you?
The man said: I heard You walking in the garden, and I was afraid. I was naked, so I hid.
The LORD God said to the man: Who told you that you were naked? Did you eat fruit from the tree I told you not to eat from?
Adam said: Lord, it was because of the woman You gave me. She gave me some of the fruit, and I ate it.
Then the LORD God said to the woman: What have you done? She said: The snake tricked me, so I ate the fruit.

So the LORD God said to the snake: Because you have done this, you are cursed more than all farm animals and every wild animal. You must crawl on your belly. You must eat dust all the days of your life.
I will make you and the woman enemies to each other. Your children and her children will be enemies too. Her child will crush your head, and you will strike her child's heel.

Then the LORD God said to the woman: I will cause you to have much trouble when you are pregnant. When you give birth to children, you will have much pain. You will want your husband very much, but he will rule over you.

Then the LORD God said to Adam: I told you not to eat the fruit from the tree that gives knowledge of good and evil. But you did not listen to Me. You listened to your wife, and you ate the fruit. Because of this, I will curse the ground. You will work hard all your life for the food the ground produces.
The ground will grow thorns and weeds for you. You will have to eat the plants that grow wild in the fields.
You will work very long and hard to get food. Your face will be wet with sweat. You will work hard until the day you die. Then you will become dust again.
Adam named his wife Eve. Adam gave her this name because Eve would be the mother of everyone who ever lived.
The LORD God used animal skins to make clothes for Adam and his wife.
The LORD God said: Look, the man has become like Us, knowing good and evil. Now the man might take the fruit from the tree of life. If the man eats that fruit, the man will live forever.
So the LORD God sent the man out of the Garden of Eden. The man had to work the ground he was taken from.
The LORD God put angels called cherubim on the east side of the garden. He also put a flaming sword there to guard the way to the tree of life. The sword flashed around and around.

verses.text: Adam made love to his wife Eve, and Eve became pregnant. Eve gave birth to a son and named him Cain. Eve said: With the help of the LORD I have given birth to a male child.
Later Eve gave birth again to Cain's brother, Abel. Abel became a shepherd, and Cain became a farmer.
After some time, Cain brought an offering to the LORD. He brought some food that he had grown from the ground.
Abel also brought an offering. He brought the first lamb born to one of his sheep and killed it. He gave the best parts of it as an offering. The LORD was pleased with Abel and his offering.
But the LORD rejected Cain's offering. Cain became very angry, and Cain's face fell in sadness.
Then the LORD said to Cain: Why are you angry? Why has your face fallen?
If you do the right thing, I will accept you. But if you do not, sin is crouching at the door, ready to attack you. Sin desires to have you, but you must rule over it.
Cain talked with Abel, Cain's brother. Cain said: Let us go out into the field. When Cain and Abel were out in the field, Cain attacked Abel and killed Abel.
The LORD asked Cain: Where is your brother Abel? Cain answered: I do not know. Am I supposed to take care of my brother?
Then the LORD said: Why have you done this terrible thing? Your brother's blood is crying out to Me from the ground.
Now you are under a curse, and you can no longer farm the soil. The ground opened its mouth and took in your brother's blood when you killed him.
If you try to grow crops, the ground will not help your plants grow. You will not have a home in this land. You will wander from place to place.
Then Cain said to the LORD: This punishment is too hard for me to bear.
You are forcing me to leave the land. I will not be able to be near You or have a home. Now I must wander from place to place, and anyone I meet could kill me.
Then the LORD said to Cain: No, if anyone kills you, I will punish that person seven times as much. Then the LORD put a mark on Cain so that no one would kill Cain.
Then Cain went away from the LORD's presence. Cain lived in the land of Nod, which is east of Eden.
Cain and his wife had a son and named him Enoch. Then Cain built a city and named it after his son, Enoch.
Enoch had a son named Irad. Irad was the father of Mehujael. Mehujael had a son named Methushael. Methushael was the father of Lamech.
Lamech had two wives, Adah and Zillah.
Adah gave birth to Jabal. Jabal was the father of people who live in tents and take care of farm animals.
Jabal's brother was Jubal. Jubal was the father of people who play the harp and flute.
Zillah gave birth to Tubalcain. Tubalcain was the father of people who make tools of bronze and iron. The sister of Tubalcain was named Naamah.
Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah: Listen to me. A man hurt me, so I killed him. I also killed a young man for hitting me.
If anyone who kills Cain will be punished seven times, then anyone who kills me will be punished seventy-seven times.
Adam and Eve made love again and had another son. Eve said: God has given me a son to replace Abel, whom Cain killed. So Eve named him Seth.
Seth had a son whom Seth named Enos. At that time people began to pray to the LORD.

verses.text: This is the story of Adam and his family. On the day God created humans, God made them like Himself.
God created them male and female. God blessed them and named them Adam.
When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son. The son was like Adam. Adam named him Seth.
After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 more years. Adam had other sons and daughters.
Adam lived 930 years in all. Then Adam died.
When Seth was 105 years old, he had a son named Enos.
After Enos was born, Seth lived 807 more years. Seth had other sons and daughters.
Seth lived 912 years in all. Then Seth died.
When Enos was 90 years old, he had a son named Cainan.
After Cainan was born, Enos lived 815 more years. Enos had other sons and daughters.
Enos lived 905 years in all. Then Enos died.
When Cainan was 70 years old, he had a son named Mahalaleel.
After Mahalaleel was born, Cainan lived 840 more years. Cainan had other sons and daughters.
Cainan lived 910 years in all. Then Cainan died.
When Mahalaleel was 65 years old, he had a son named Jared.
After Jared was born, Mahalaleel lived 830 more years. Mahalaleel had other sons and daughters.
Mahalaleel lived 895 years in all. Then Mahalaleel died.
When Jared was 162 years old, he had a son named Enoch.
After Enoch was born, Jared lived 800 more years. Jared had other sons and daughters.
Jared lived 962 years in all. Then Jared died.
When Enoch was 65 years old, he had a son named Methuselah.
After Methuselah was born, Enoch walked with God for 300 more years. Enoch had other sons and daughters.
Enoch lived 365 years in all.
Enoch walked with God. Then Enoch was gone, because God took him.
When Methuselah was 187 years old, he had a son named Lamech.
After Lamech was born, Methuselah lived 782 more years. Methuselah had other sons and daughters.
Methuselah lived 969 years in all. Then Methuselah died.
When Lamech was 182 years old, he had a son.
Lamech named his son Noah. Lamech said: This son will comfort us in our work and the hard labor of our hands. He will comfort us on the ground the LORD has cursed.
After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 more years. Lamech had other sons and daughters.
Lamech lived 777 years in all. Then Lamech died.
When Noah was 500 years old, he had sons named Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.text: The number of people on earth continued to increase, and these people had daughters.
Some of the angels saw that these daughters were beautiful. They married the daughters they wanted.
Then the LORD said: My Spirit will not struggle with humans forever, because humans are flesh. Humans will live only 120 years.
In that time there were giants on earth. The giants were the children of the angels who had married the people's daughters. The giants were very strong soldiers, and everyone knew about them.
The LORD saw that the people on the earth were very evil. The LORD saw that people thought only about evil things all the time.
The LORD was sorry that the LORD had made people on the earth. It made the LORD very sad.

So the LORD said: I will destroy all the people I created on the earth. I will destroy every person and every animal and everything that crawls on the earth. And I will destroy all the birds in the air, because I am sorry that I have made them.
But Noah pleased the LORD.
This is the story of Noah and his family. Noah was a good man who did what was right. Noah was the only person of his time who had no fault. Noah walked with God.
Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
The earth was full of evil in God's sight, and the earth was filled with violence.
God looked at the earth and saw that it was full of evil, because all people on the earth had lived evil lives.
God said to Noah: The end of all living things has come. I have decided to destroy them, because the earth is filled with violence because of them. I will destroy them along with the earth.
God told Noah: Use gopher wood to build an ark. You must build rooms in the ark. Put tar over the wood, inside and outside.
This is the size I want you to make the ark: 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits high. A cubit is about 1.5 feet. So the ark will be about 450 feet long, 75 feet wide and 45 feet high.
Make a window in the ark, one cubit below the roof. Put a door in the side of the ark. Make three floors in the ark: a bottom floor, a middle floor, and a top floor.
Listen: I am going to bring a great flood of water on the earth. I will destroy every living thing that has the breath of life. Everything on the earth will die.
I will make My agreement with you. You, your wife, your sons, and your sons' wives will all go into the ark.
Also bring two of every living thing into the ark with you. Bring a male and a female of each kind, so they can stay alive with you.
Two of every kind of bird, farm animal, and animal that crawls on the ground will come to you. You must keep them alive.
Also take every kind of food and store it. It will be food for you and for the animals.
Noah did everything exactly as God had commanded.

verses.text: Then the LORD said to Noah: Go into the ark, you and all your family. I have seen that you are a good man among the people of this time.
Take with you 7 pairs of every kind of clean animal, male and female. Take 1 pair of every kind of animal that is not clean, male and female.
Also take 7 pairs of every kind of bird, male and female. Do this to keep them alive on the earth.
In 7 days I will send rain on the earth. It will rain for 40 days and 40 nights. I will wipe from the earth every living thing I have made.
Noah did everything the LORD commanded him.
Noah was 600 years old when the flood waters came on the earth.
Noah went into the ark to escape the flood waters. His sons, his wife, and his sons' wives went in with him.
Animals of every kind came to Noah. There were clean animals and animals that are not clean. There were birds and everything that crawls on the ground.
They went into the ark with Noah, 2 by 2, male and female. They went in just as God had commanded Noah.
After 7 days, the flood waters came on the earth.
It was the 600th year of Noah's life. On the 17th day of the 2nd month, all the underground waters burst open. The windows of the sky were opened.
Rain fell on the earth for 40 days and 40 nights.
On that same day, Noah went into the ark. His sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth went in with him. Noah's wife and the 3 wives of his sons went in too.
Every kind of animal was with them. There were wild animals, farm animals, animals that crawl on the ground, and birds of every kind.
They came to Noah and went into the ark, 2 by 2. Every living thing that breathes came.
The animals that went in were male and female of every kind, just as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD shut Noah in.
The flood continued for 40 days on the earth. The waters rose and lifted the ark high above the ground.
The waters rose higher and higher, and the ark floated on top of the water.
The waters rose so high that they covered even the highest mountains everywhere under the sky.
The water rose about 22 feet above the mountains. The mountains were covered completely.
Every living thing on the earth died. This included the birds, the farm animals, the wild animals, every creature, and all the people.
Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in it died.
God wiped out every living thing on the earth. That included people, animals, crawling creatures and birds. Only Noah was left, and those with him in the ark.
The waters covered the earth for 150 days.
God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and farm animals with him in the ark. God sent a wind over the earth, and the water began to go down.
The underground waters and the windows of the sky were closed. The rain stopped falling from the sky.
The water went down from the earth little by little. After 150 days, the water was much lower.
On the 17th day of the 7th month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
The water kept going down until the 10th month. On the 1st day of the 10th month, the tops of the mountains could be seen.
After 40 more days, Noah opened the window he had made in the ark.
Noah sent out a raven. The raven flew back and forth until the water dried up from the earth.
Then Noah sent out a dove, to see if the water had gone down from the ground.
The dove found no place to land, because water covered all the earth. The dove came back to Noah in the ark. Noah reached out his hand and took the dove. He brought it back into the ark.
Noah waited 7 more days. Then Noah sent the dove out of the ark again.
In the evening the dove came back to Noah. The dove had a fresh olive leaf in its mouth. So Noah knew that the water had gone down from the earth.
Noah waited 7 more days. Then Noah sent the dove out again. This time the dove did not come back.
It was Noah's 601st year, the 1st day of the 1st month. The water had dried up from the earth. Noah removed the cover of the ark and looked. The ground was dry.
By the 27th day of the 2nd month, the earth was completely dry.
Then God spoke to Noah.
God said: Go out of the ark, you and your wife, your sons, and your sons' wives.

Bring out every living thing that is with you. Bring out the birds, the animals and everything that crawls on the ground. Let them have many young ones on the earth. Let them grow in number and fill the earth.
So Noah went out of the ark with his sons, his wife, and his sons' wives.
Every animal, every creature that crawls, and every bird went out of the ark. Each kind went out with its own kind.
Then Noah built an altar for the LORD. Noah took some of every clean animal and every clean bird. Noah offered them as burnt offerings on the altar.

The LORD smelled the sweet smell. The LORD said in His heart: I will never again curse the ground because of humans. This is so even though humans think evil from the time they are young. I will never again destroy every living thing, as I have done.
As long as the earth lasts, there will always be a time to plant and a time to harvest. There will always be cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night.

verses.text: God blessed Noah and his sons. God said to them: Have many children. Fill the earth again with your people.
Every animal on earth and every bird in the air will be afraid of you. So will every animal that crawls and every fish in the sea. All of them will be under your control.
In the past, I gave you the green plants to eat. Now every animal will also be food for you. I give you everything on earth. It is yours.
But you must not eat meat that still has blood in it. Blood is like the life of someone.
I will demand an answer for the blood of your lives. I will demand it from every animal. I will also demand a human life from every other human, even from a brother.
Whoever sheds human blood, that person's blood will be shed by other humans, because God made humans in His own image.
Noah, you must have many children and their children must have more children. The earth must be full of people.
God said to Noah and his sons:
I, God, now make My agreement with you and with your people who will live after you.
I am also making this agreement with all the birds and the animals that were in the ark with you.
This is My agreement with you: Never again will a flood destroy all life on the earth.
God said to Noah: I will give you a sign of the agreement I have made. It is with you and with all the people and animals. I will remember this forever.
I have put My rainbow in the sky. The rainbow is the sign of this agreement between Me and the earth.
When I bring clouds over the earth, you will see the rainbow in the clouds.
When I see this rainbow, I will remember My agreement. It is between Me, you and every living thing on the earth. This rainbow says that a flood will never again destroy all life on the earth.
When I look and see the rainbow in the clouds, I will remember the agreement that lasts forever. It is between Me and every living thing on the earth.
So God said to Noah: This rainbow is the sign of the agreement that I made with all living things on earth.
Noah's sons came out of the ark with Noah. Their names were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)
These 3 men were Noah's sons. All the people on earth came from these 3 sons.
Noah became a farmer and planted a vineyard.
One day Noah drank too much wine and became drunk. Noah lay uncovered inside his tent.
Ham, the father of Canaan, saw that his father was naked and told his brothers who were outside the tent.
Shem and Japheth took a robe and put it across their shoulders. They walked backward into the tent. Then they covered their father without looking at him.
So Noah awoke from his wine and knew what his younger son had done to him.
Noah said: May there be a curse on Canaan. May Canaan be a servant to his brothers.
Noah also said: Praise the LORD, the God of Shem. Canaan will be Shem's servant.
I pray that God will give Japheth more and more fields and land. Japheth will live in Shem's tents. Canaan will be Japheth's servant.
After the flood Noah lived 350 years.
Noah lived a total of 950 years, and Noah died.
